visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable views, including the 1024×640 summary. The gold bulb dome over a slotted white drum, tall square minaret with an open crown, gold-capped corner chattris, pointed porticos with deep timber doors, opaque pointed windows and long flat wings are present. The separate Mahligai has upturned closed hull ends, two steep side pavilion roofs, a three-tier central open pavilion and a curved bridge. Corrected hidden portal doors, a window behind a turret, missing bow inner faces, roof undersides and roof-cap seams before final review. Fine ornament, calligraphy, heraldry and unseen interiors remain omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 shared/geographic-flat views. Six existing 256² limestone, continuous limestone, standing-seam metal, cast bronze, plain wood and concrete graphs serve seven merged roles including local opaque glazing. Metric UVs and linear tints; zero embedded images or unique facade atlases. Every graph is read once, and eviction leaves zero live model geometries. The north-up overlay matches the retained mosque footprint and orientation; the barge follows the mapped lagoon hole and the approach follows the tagged bridge. The flat fixture omits lagoon water; terrain/medium-fi views use a separate review water plane. This does not approve surveyed shore or tidal contact. Supplemental runtime compatibility review 2026-10-18: inspected all 11 freshly forced shared-material/geographic-flat views after adding support for the source-declared two groundCutout.outlines. The main mosque and detached Mahligai barge both keep their openings; the intervening ground stays. Existing source, runtime, model-input and placement hashes are unchanged. Fresh capture confirms the main opening is active, its probe is uncovered, shared textures remain reused and eviction restores the ground with zero live model geometries. The public schema accepts the entire real placement catalog. Current focused tests cover separated openings with scale/yaw, bounded clipping, invalid rings and restoration. Flat review omits lagoon water and does not certify current shore/tide joins. Portable and medium-fi reviews retain their original unchanged-model scope.
